description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to latest LTS versions

tasks.description: Upgrade to Java 25 and Spring Boot 4.x with Spring Framework 7.x and Jakarta EE migration
tasks.reason: Migrate to the latest LTS versions to benefit from long-term support, performance improvements, new language features, and security patches. Spring Boot 4.x requires Java 25 and includes Spring Framework 7.x.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to 25, Spring Boot to 4.x, Spring Framework to 7.x, and migrate javax.* imports to jakarta.* namespace as required by Jakarta EE. Update all dependency versions in build files to be compatible with Spring Boot 4.x. Ensure all existing functionality is preserved after the upgrade.
